name_original: Casio - Men's Digital Sport Watch - Stainless Steel
description_original: Casio Men's Digital Sport Watch: Manage your busy day with this digital sport watch that features a world time clock and a 48-city world time zone map, so you can keep track of time on the go. The flexible stainless-steel band offers good looks and durability.
